en: Colorized historic postcard showing a grand corner building in an urban square. The building has ornate Neo‑Baroque / Secessionist architecture with a domed roof, elaborate window frames, and columns over the main entrance. Pedestrians walk around the square and a small kiosk or monument with a red roof is visible in the foreground. Printed captions at the top identify the subject and location.
